name: Graham Kingley
original_name: グレアム・キングリー
source:
In 2031, the Japanese-American United National Defense Force was formed, through the union of the U.S. Armed Forces and the Japan Self-Defense Force, to bolster the Japanese-American Allied Forces.

Graham serves as a soldier of their Special Forces Group; he is 42 years old.

He commands a unit tasked with guarding the Gai Institution and Asuma, per top-secret orders passed down by the Ministry of Defense.

[From [url=https://www.kirikiribasara.com/2022/06/08/anonymouscode-character-profile-translations/]Kiri Kiri Basara[/url]]
